lines.text: My grandma is the GOAT of soup.

data.define: A word for the best person in their field; it stands for greatest of all time.

example.text: My grandma is the GOAT of soup.

misuse.text: Don't say 'GOAT' while pointing at a farm animal.
misuse.why: It means greatest ever, not the animal.

publish.title: What does "GOAT" mean?
publish.value: GOAT = The greatest of all time. Example: "My grandma is the GOAT of soup." (casual English).
